Name: (CP) Insightful Harriet- Portrait only
Author: AlcoveWorks
Description:
[size=4]This mod adds CP portrait of female Harvey (Harriet) that looks more mature / young adult, for anyone who prefer less-Kawaii Portrait.
Has Normal, Winter, and two Beach outfit option.
Doesn't include sprite or changing her name in-game...yet.
If you wants to change the dialogue and name, I prefer you to use. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url].

[b]HOW TO INSTALL : [/b]
- Download and install all requirements
- Download and unzip the mod files
- Move the files to your SMAPI mod folder

[b]CAUTION :[/b]
Make sure other Portrait mods that affect Harvey are turned off in the config, to avoid a clash.

NOTES :
This is the third stand-alone portrait, you can either download this, or wait until I finished every Bachelor, later with the mod's name : Femful Valley. its gonna take long time...[/size]

[size=4]If some of the outfit failed to appear pls let me know
